title: NYMEX-Tokyo platinum dual-venue synchronized forward-FX adjusted executable quote spread scanner

source_confirmed_rules.rule: The study defines two directions of platinum NYMEX–TOCOM quote arbitrage using NY/TO bid–ask and USD/JPY forward rate
Study analyzes the connection of possible arbitrage opportunity to liquidity, not a guaranteed net-profit execution recipe

research_assumptions.value: NY 50 troy oz against Tokyo 3 × 500 g
research_assumptions.why: Lot approximation; historical/current venue specs must be checked, residual exposure exists

research_assumptions.value: Forward bid/ask for synthetic quote replay
research_assumptions.why: No actual forward contract hedge, cash flows proxy; not locked FX arbitrage
Net of illustrative 8000 JPY roundtrip fees, research threshold

research_assumptions.value: Net entry edge compression or 3 snapshots
research_assumptions.why: Developed exit rule; paper does not prescribe
Research quality gate; not paper executable policy

hypothesis: At overlapping sessions the executable two-way platinum prices can deviate enough to cover known FX/spread/fees; real transfer and hedging risks remain.
